blocks.text: TOKYO — Japan said Tuesday it scrambled fighter jets after two suspected Russian aircraft violated its airspace, and lodged a “very stern protest” with Moscow. The aircraft entered Japan’s airspace close to Okinoshima, in the southwestern area of Fukuoka, shortly after 4:00 am Tuesday (1900 GMT Monday). Japan’s self defense force scrambled fighter jets to warn the “suspected Russian” planes, top government spokesman Minoru Kihara said.
